title: Pacer Rules – WSER
claims: A runner may have one pacer at a time from Foresthill (mile 62) to the finish; a runner leaving Michigan Bluff after 20:00 may start pacing there.
Pacer changes are allowed only at Foresthill, Rucky Chucky north side, Green Gate, Pointed Rocks and Robie Point.
Pacers must be at least 18; they may help fill bottles but may not carry the runner's water, food, lights, shoes or clothing.
Muling is expressly forbidden, and pacers may not provide mechanical or physical assistance on the course.
Since 2025, pacers and crew are not allowed along Bath Road and must wait inside the official Foresthill area.

claimVerification.note: 规则第 1 条写 Foresthill mile 62 起可陪跑，Michigan Bluff 20:00 后也可。
规则列出五个换陪跑点。
规则写 18 岁、可帮忙灌水但不得携带选手装备。
规则明确禁止 muling 与机械/身体辅助。
规则写明 2025 起 Bath Road 禁 pacer/crew。
